headline: IMF Forecasts Double-Digit 2026 GDP Contractions for Four Oil Exporters
summary: The IMF warned four oil-exporting nations will suffer double-digit economic contractions in 2026, assuming the Strait of Hormuz begins reopening in March with normalization by late 2027.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical crude oil transit chokepoint; prolonged closures cause major global supply and revenue disruptions.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Severe regional export disruptions and shipping chokepoint closures restrict global crude supply.
